title: Setup: build Iceberg api/core/data/parquet at both #12855 revisions and run TestGenericRecord and TestGenericReaderDeletes
description: Setup for case L14 of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-l01-l20-brief.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/worktrees (L14-iceberg-fix = a7f3dc79a2f42a4875ac35eec2137ecff15204fc, L14-iceberg-parent = 4ca3f10832907540eee798236fa401eb07c7e7df), runs the upstream Gradle build (Gradle 8.14, sha256 checked against services.gradle.org and the wrapper's distributionSha256Sum; JDK 17.0.21; --no-scan; dependencies already resolved inline): the api, common, core, data, parquet and bundled-guava jars and :iceberg-data:test for TestGenericRecord and TestGenericReaderDeletes (parameterized over formats and format versions), on the fix (first build may go online) then offline, on the parent offline, then the fix's DeleteReadTests, TestGenericReaderDeletes and TestGenericRecord transplanted onto the parent (the new binary-key and copy tests are expected to fail). Copies each side's jars, runtime classpaths (data, parquet, data test runtime with hadoop-client) and class digests into ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/artifacts; JUnit summaries to .../logs; worktrees restored and cleaned. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-l01-l20-brief-setup.md.
expected: every step exits 0: fix tests pass online and offline, parent's own pass, the transplant prints TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED or TRANSPLANT-DOES-NOT-COMPILE; artifacts and classpath files for both sides
